item.title: Analyst Predicts The Ethereum Price Bottom With A Marked Path To $15,000
item.description: Despite the Ethereum price looking to be leveling out below $2,000, the slowdown in the crash has done nothing to allay fears that more decline is coming. In fact, analysts believe that this stop is only temporary and that the second-largest cryptocurrency by market cap will make another major drop soon.
